title: LeviMC project identity concepts
status: Unofficial concepts for review. The /official/ route is a directory label, not an approval claim.

reference.name: LeviLamina official vector identity
reference.style_note: Organic botanical silhouettes, layered forest-green fills and restrained sage contrasts, based on the current official vector mark.

projects.name: LegacyScriptEngine
projects.summary: A maintained compatibility layer for mods from the earlier Bedrock loader ecosystem.
projects.subtitle: Legacy runtime compatibility

variants.label: Heritage leaf
variants.description: A maintained legacy crest: layered record plates, a mature botanical branch and a continuous lower stem express predecessor lineage without implying abandonment.

variants.label: Two-era bridge
variants.description: Two connected generations share one living stem, representing older scripts and APIs continuing inside the modern LeviLamina runtime.

variants.label: Runtime strata
variants.description: Three substantial runtime strata are joined by a shared botanical spine to represent language and API compatibility.

projects.name: lip
projects.summary: A general-purpose package installer that resolves packages and their dependencies through one command.
projects.subtitle: Package and dependency installer

variants.label: Package lattice
variants.description: Three interlocking isometric package modules form a compact dependency lattice; the Levi botanical mark is embedded into the central package face.

variants.label: Dependency constellation
variants.description: A rooted package graph connects a primary package to dependent modules, showing resolution and installation order rather than delivery or shopping.

variants.label: Modular cube
variants.description: A faceted installer core opens into three removable, linked modules; the central leaf acts as the package system's identity rather than a decorative sticker.

projects.name: LeviAntiCheat
projects.summary: A technical protection and detection identity for monitoring suspicious activity.
projects.subtitle: Protection and detection

variants.label: Guardian aperture
variants.description: A layered shield encloses a multi-ring scanning aperture with a leaf-shaped detection core, combining protection and active inspection.

variants.label: Scan vault
variants.description: A sealed technical enclosure uses a rotating scan ring, radial notches and a protected leaf core to suggest integrity checks and detection.

variants.label: Radar sentinel
variants.description: A segmented radial sweep sits behind a compact shield, giving the symbol a monitoring-first reading without weapon or combat cues.

projects.name: LeviOptimize
projects.summary: A performance optimization project for reducing overhead across computational hot paths.
projects.subtitle: Performance and efficiency

variants.label: Processing core
variants.description: A six-sided compute engine combines a layered central core, precision channels and a botanical processing motif. It signals system efficiency without a generic speedometer.

variants.label: Pipeline flow
variants.description: Three controlled execution channels converge through a compact leaf-bearing processor, representing streamlined work and reduced redundant processing.

variants.label: Layered engine
variants.description: Nested computational plates and aligned routing channels depict optimizations applied across several hot paths, with a leaf at the shared execution junction.

projects.name: MoreDimensions
projects.summary: A science-fiction dimensional architecture API for adding custom Bedrock dimensions.
projects.subtitle: Spatial and dimensional API

variants.label: Dimensional arch
variants.description: A nested, engineered portal uses layered elliptical frames, coordinate markers and a floating dimensional core. The leaf is embedded as the transition anchor.

variants.label: Coordinate cube
variants.description: A dimensional wireframe cube intersects multiple offset coordinate planes, with a living botanical core marking the stable point between spaces.

variants.label: Parallel frames
variants.description: Three overlapping portal planes show parallel dimensional spaces and the transitions between them, avoiding a literal Nether-portal silhouette.

projects.name: bedboo
projects.summary: A bot library with a Mineflayer-compatible API surface and a Bedrock-focused identity.
projects.subtitle: Bot library and API bridge

variants.label: Bot bridge
variants.description: A custom bot core is framed by API connection ports and a botanical antenna, conveying programmable agents and Mineflayer-compatible integration.

variants.label: API bridge
variants.description: A central agent node connects to three differently shaped API ports, making the integration and transport layer the main visual idea.

variants.label: Autonomous agent
variants.description: A compact modular agent silhouette includes directional sensor fins, an articulated base and a leaf-shaped status mark.

projects.name: LeviMC Mods
projects.summary: A curated catalogue for discovering and browsing LeviMC-compatible mods and tools.
projects.subtitle: Mod discovery and catalogue

variants.label: Curated catalogue
variants.description: A structured catalogue of modular cards is arranged around a central discovery mark, balancing browsing, curation and the Levi botanical family cue.

variants.label: Discovery orbit
variants.description: A discovery lens follows a ring of modular entries, representing search, sorting and exploration across a growing mod ecosystem.

variants.label: Module shelf
variants.description: A tiered set of installed module tiles sits in a stable catalogue frame, with an embedded leaf marking the curated source.
